name: manual_df6827
claim: For web-based agents in an ephemeral command sandbox, the filesystem can disappear between turns while conversation context survives. Commit and push each independently verified unit promptly; after a reset, re-clone and re-verify tools, files, and tests from scratch while continuing on the same branch name. This recovery discipline differs from persistent local command-line sessions and does not relax test-first verification.

decisions.notes: This recovery strategy was recorded for web-based agents in ephemeral sandboxes so they preserve verified work and do not mistake surviving conversation context for a surviving checkout.
